title: Concept: Maven repository serves snapshots to this build
description: pom.xml declares a repository with snapshot resolution enabled, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Snapshots are rebuilt in place, so the resolved artifact can change between two runs that use the same pom.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through pom.xml (maven).
risk: Snapshots are rebuilt in place, so the resolved artifact can change between two runs that use the same pom.
